Description: adurefs — Shared Filesystem Volume Driver for Docker Swarm

Env.Name: ADUREFS_BASE_PATH
Env.Description: Internal mount path inside the plugin container — must match Mounts.Destination

Env.Name: ADUREFS_HOST_PATH
Env.Description: Host-side path of the shared filesystem (returned as Mountpoint to Docker)

Env.Name: ADUREFS_KEEP_DATA
Env.Description: When true, Remove only deletes the volume record — data on the filesystem is preserved

Env.Name: ADUREFS_LOG_LEVEL
Env.Description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR

Mounts.Name: volumes
Mounts.Description: Shared filesystem directory bind-mounted into the plugin for directory management
